scenarios.expectation: A matching connection header can initialize and observe this endpoint's health.
Initialization and every tool entry reject a missing expected Vault ID before dispatch.
Initialization and every tool entry reject a mismatched expected Vault ID without read-only degradation.
Only the minimal incompatible health projection remains available and uses isError false.
Two open Managed Vaults keep identity, endpoint, state, and health evidence isolated.
Compatibility text parses to the exact authoritative structuredContent value.
One heterogeneous read preserves duplicate request indices, exact UTF-8 bytes, BOM, newline spelling, CJK, astral Unicode, and canonical Content Versions.
A complete heading hierarchy with an unsatisfied one-based occurrence returns not_satisfied without alternate content.
A note over 1 MiB returns the typed limit result; aggregate Exact Reads over 1 MiB return only deterministic ordered contiguous groups.
A content-blocking operational gate returns operationally_blocked before any raw byte access.
Invalid UTF-8 produces no trustworthy vault_read product result and never becomes not_satisfied.
Every compact continuation page is within 256 KiB and contiguous per-index UTF-8 ranges reconstruct the accepted frozen Exact Read after Vault bytes change.
Every token is single-use and client-bound; each replacement starts a new 15-minute lifetime while consumed, expired, malformed, and wrong-client tokens expose only continuation_unavailable.
Eight live chains or 8 MiB retained bytes reject new issuance without eviction, and completion, expiry, rejection, session teardown, and Bridge teardown immediately release capacity.
A content-blocking effective gate returns operationally_blocked before inspecting or consuming a continuation token.
